The rubber matches my Chemex beautifully, Washes well.
**UPDATED**
It fell in the Chemex, The Chemex survived. This filter didn't. The bottom part came off and won't fit back in. ):
easy clean-better brew!

I've made coffee in my Chemex 4 days in a row now that I have this awesome finer to use. Before, we were folding machine filters and since that took 2 paper filters and time, we rarely used the Chemex. Grounds need a little help to get out of the filter after being used and dried, but that's the only negative at this point. Tasty brew, environmentally friendly, and pretty easy to use. Can't complain!
High quality product.

It "fits" a 10 cup Chemex pot, but good luck trying to brew 10 cups. I asked about capacity before I purchased and was told 26 tablespoons. You can't effectively bloom the coffee as directed, because you can't add enough water without overflowing. The first 2 pours had to be less than 80 gram of water. The next few pours improve slightly to 150 - 200 grams. But for 90 grams of coffee (a full 10 cups of coffee) you should bloom with 180 grams, then pour 250 - 300 grams of water until you reach 1450 grams total water. You end up with muddy, lukewarm coffee with this filter.

I have not yet found a metal filter that lets me brew as I can with paper. So, paper it will be.
Love this filter. It's perfect!
Much better than paper filters. Easy to keep clean.
I worked as advertised! No metal taste!
Amazing filter and I love that it's reusable and cuts back on paper filter waste. Worth the investment :)

Delivery was fast and the product is fantastic! I LOVE not having to deal w/paper filters anymore and if you follow the directions - you won't have any issues w/the clogging that other ppl seem to have (havent experienced any of that!)

We had been using a reusable linen filter with our Chemex. By comparison, this is way easier to use - it's not floppy - and way easier to clean. We use the coarsest ground setting when we get coffee; smaller grounds seem to clog the filter, and then it takes a really long time to brew a pot. Coarse grounds work great, though.
My wife loves it for her chemex.  So much better than buying the paper filters over and over.
Filter was received. Thanks

I purchased this filter on July 5, or a little less than 2 months ago. It's worked great up until a few days ago, but now the water will not filter through, effectively making the filter useless. I've tried soaking it, scrubbing by hand, and running it through the dishwasher (without the rubber seal). So far nothing has worked. I grind my own beans and haven't changed anything about the grind - it just stopped working. According to Amazon it is too late to return, hence the 1-star review. If the company contacts me and can offer a solution or a replacement filter, I will happily update this review. Until then, buyer beware...
Product received as advertised. Very happy with this purchase. The rim matches well with my ChemDex coffeemaker.
I'm so happy with my purchase! I was surprised by the quality of the filter! It brews a much more flavorful cup than a paper filter. I'd recommend it to anyone!
Easy to clean, coffee produced has great flavor. Arrived in timely fashion. No complaints.

Fantastic product. So glad we chose this filter instead of paper. It works so well and is a beautifully engineered piece of equipment! Willow and Everett were amazing to deal with, with excellent customer service and communication.  Will definitely purchase from them again
Coffee filter works great and is easy to clean.

This really is the BEST metal filter on Amazon. I bought two other filters that were nowhere near as good as this one. The first one had too fine of a mesh and would clog after every brew. The other just had a single filter with small holes. Water would drain too quick and fines would get through resulting in a weak watery "dirty" coffee. But this filter is just right. The mesh filter is just big enough to let the coffee seep and fine enough to not let sediment through. Some oil can get through but produces a bigger, bolder cup than paper filters with no sediment.

I use a grind between french press and pour over to control the water flow for both hot and iced coffee. You can grind finer for a bigger bodied cup or coarser for a cleaner cup. Either way this filter performs and is easy to clean. Just experiment to find your grind size because this filter will perform based on that.

Dont waste time and money on other filters when this one hits the mark.

So far I've only made coffee a handful of times but I really like this filter. I'll update if my experience changes

EDIT: after several months of regular use this filter simply doesn't drain. It will take 15+ minutes to make a cup of coffee and I have tried scrubbing, soaking, pressure hose, etc. I'm using the exact same grind size or even larger than I used to. I don't know what's going on but it's frustrating. I have tried everything to clean it, including taking it to work to use a power washer. No luck. I finally ripped the mesh away from the holes and it was all gunked up with coffee sediment. It makes a good cup of coffee with the mesh removed now.

PROS: Very attractive design, easier to reuse a filter than keep a bunch of paper filters around, I really missed the extra flavors of the residual oils that paper traps. I had the best cup of coffee I've had in months with this.

CONS: You have to clean it after use; the mesh filter is extremely fine and will clog if you don't clean it.

I also received a lovely email from the company that makes them with care instructions and a direct contact line in case anything goes wrong. I didn't need to contact them, everything works great, but I love the quality service of these smaller companies that work through Amazon. Thanks!

I absolutely love love this filter. Aside from being less wasteful, it functions perfectly. Keep in mind that I use a Burr grinder and have been able to set it to a grind that won't slip through the mesh. I suppose if you don't have a consistent grind, you may find more soot at the bottom of your coffee jug/carafe. In my case, it has been an absolute joy. I love the seal it creates as well. Keep in mind, I use a Chemex which this works perfectly for; it doesn't fit quite as snug on my Hario, which would be a problem.

So, based on the fact that I have a Burr grinder and a Chemex, this product works perfectly. If you have an inconsistent grind you may have an issue. You may also have a problem with it if you're using the wrong carafe.

Zero complaints.

Not bad, but makes slightly bitter coffee. This is the same design as the Osaka product, which I tried (probably same manufacturer). After trying this, I went back to the Able Brewing Kone filter, which is frustratingly expensive at 60 bucks. (My original Able Kone got stepped on). Anyway, this design is very well made, but actually has two layers (screen and perforated metal sheet). It also has a flat spot in the bottom. My theory is that the Able Kone, which does not have the two-layer design or flat spot, has better water-flow through the coffee. This prevents bitterness, I believe. Note that I have been using metal filters for years, and tested this design a couple of weeks. I tried adjusting my grind and changing my pouring technique. Nothing stopped the bitterness.

In case anyone is doubting my technique, here it is:

70 grams of quality beans, ground medium on a Virtuoso burr grinder, Able Kone filter with Chemex glass carafe. Water boiled and then poured into a cool stainless pouring carafe. Wet, the grounds, wait a minute, and then pour slow and steady over the grounds. This creates a strong brew that gets rave reviews.

(And no, I don't work for Able or any other coffee-related company. I'm just a coffee dependent guy looking out for my fellow jittery Johns and Janes.)
This is a great reusable coffee filter. It fits perfectly and it's easy to clean.
Love this filter!
I don't know how we went so long with disposable filters! This is a fantastic product, and is insanely easy to clean! Absolutely worth the investment.

I've had this for just a few weeks, and I'm hoping to return it and just use paper filters. The mesh is so fine that it takes about 30 minutes to make 8 cups of coffee, and by the end, I'm moving the grounds with a spoon to let water through. If there's an obvious reason for this, please tell me how to get around it!

Love this...such a great alternative to the paper filter. Take your time to let the coffee bloom. Brew slowly even though the temptation will be to fill the filter with your water. Drip coffee takes some patience but it's worth it!

This is the best purchase I've made in a good while. I would always forget to order more filters for my chemex, and this has solved the problem! It's efficient, eco-friendly, and helps the brewing process.
Plus, the company is so helpful by sending you directions as well as checking in to see how things are going!

This has saved me so much time and money. Gone are the days of buying boxes of paper filters. I use this on the daily and it saves me time and money. I'm addicted to coffee and this sustains my addiction. Anyone that owns a Chemex should own this.

Ordered the filter along with the Electric pour over pot. The pot is super fast at heating water to perfect temp for pour over coffee or tea. The filter is the real deal. Hated buying paper filters and throwing them away. Works perfectly. Great upgrade to my Saturday morning coffee making.

Yes, this is expensive for a coffee filter, but the craftsmanship is impressive, not a grind will slip past this filter.  I use this with my Chemex coffee pot and I have never tasted cleaner coffee...there will be no muddy residue left at the bottom of your cup.
We love our coffee filter! So easy to clean, use, and overall a great product. Would highly recommend.
This coffee filter works really well and the coffee tastes so good! Definitely a good cost saving and waste reducing option.

Works well, especially if you run some vinegar through it on a regular basis. It started draining pretty slow, but that seems to just be that oils had collected. I put it in some hot water with vinegar and it cleared right up.
First mesh coffee filter I've used that doesn't leave any grounds behind.
This thing works a treat!  No more feeling guilty about paper filters.
Much more efficient than buying paper filters. Easy clean up. No issues so far and its been 2 months.

I was reluctant to switch from paper to metal, but this have worked out nicely. easy to clean, strains water at a good speed. ***UPDATE*** DONT BUY IT, This is Junk, its stopped working after the 16th use.  Meshscreen stopped allowing water flow. Waste of Money, I went back to Paper till i find another product.

I like the material and the design, but unfortunately it doesn't work well as a filter. There's not enough space for both the coffee grounds and the water. It should have an additional 1 inch lip like the paper filters do.
Excellent product and great buy for the price. We will save a lot of money on disposable Chemex filter. Fast shipping as well and great seller!
Awesome filter.  Makes the process of crafting a cup of coffee much quicker.  Cleanup is easy and it seems really sturdy.  Glad to have purchased it.
This filter is awesome.
I absolutely love my new coffee filter. No waste and it much quicker than paper filters. So glad I bought this! Great quality!

I've waited 4 1/2 months before doing the review. I had a similarly styled filter (though without the rubber ring around the top) and it came apart at the seam within a month or so. I bought another and treated it more delicately. It came apart in the same way. This one remains sound. I'm happy with it

This is my FAVORITE drip coffee cone. I have a few that sit over the cup which i love love love, but when I was given a chemex I needed to get one of these. I bought 2 different ones to see which one I liked and if I liked both then I would always have a clean one. Well this one was perfect. The design and manufacturing ensures that no returns will be necessary. Amazing build and I say that because the other one came in 2 pieces that looked like they were glued together. Gross. This one has the wholes punched just the right size so that the coffee drips at a steady pace and doesn't release any of the coffee. I love
I purchased it for my wife for Mother's Day.  She was using a french press.  She loves this filter and coffee system.
Great. Better than paper
Love the item, working very well. No more paper filters that break!

I thought I was being eco friendly by purchasing this product, little did I know it would take FOREVER for the water to strain through. No matter how fine I grind the coffee beans, it still takes way too long to filter through. I will be going back to the wasteful paper filters.
This filter is easy to clean and produces great pour-over coffee in our 6 cup Chemex.
Fits my Chemex perfectly and brews an excellent cup of coffee.

This is an AMAZING filter!! I was using a filter before this that left a film at the bottom of the coffee and this filter does not do this at all. This literally has transformed my coffee drinking experience.

I wish the listing was more clear about how this fits in a larger chemex. The listing says this item fits the larger chemex, and indeed it does fit in the opening. However, the filter sits low enough in the chemex that the grounds would overflow the top of it if you did anything but dribble water onto a very small amount of coffee grounds. So yes, it will fit in a larger chemex, but you can only make a small amount of coffee in it regardless of the size of the chemex.
Works well. Easy to clean. Better than using paper filters.

This is a great coffee filter. It does take a little longer to brew the coffee than it did with paper filters. I am going to try grinding the coffee a little coarser to see if that helps some. I have the 8 cup Chemex. I just wish the filter was slightly larger so the top rim of the filter actually sat on the rim of the carafe instead of inside it. I would recommend this filter.
I am really liking this filter!!  The rubber ring around the top removes easily for cleaning and protects the glass lip nicely.

i bought a single metal filter similar to this one, unfortunately it filters exactly the same way. my problem with these two filters is the fact that you need to wash them every time with soap to even get them to sort of work. and for real coffee drinkers you can taste the soap. they used to fine a mesh for coffee and i will be going back to paper, big waste of money.  the people i bought it from sent it quickly and in good condition.
I'm enjoying some of the best coffee I've had in a long time. This filter is super! Thanks

I’ve used this with my v60 for a couple weeks now in favor of paper filters. It behaves much like a paper filter in that I didn’t change my brewing process at all, and each cup comes out like I’d expect. The only drawback I can see is that it takes a little more time for cleanup vs a disposable filter. I’m excited to try this in my Chemex soon.

As classy as the Chemex Design itself!
I've had a Chemex since the early 1970's as a 22 year old. Besides the one of a kind design part of the appeal for me was folding the full circle paper filters ......
They seem to have become extinct.
I chose the Willow and Everett reusable for its style,construction,and the matching brown rubber gasket. It's a shiny & sharp addition to my Chemex display. Coffee grounds are good for the pipes so I easily invert the filter over the drain and pour water over the cone to clear the screen. Remove the gasket ,wipe everything to a shine and Voila ready for another bit of brewing.

but to include a handle to lift the filter for pouring would absolutely detour the perfect design.
If there's no full circle filters to be had,
I'm glad I searched and found
Camille's Silver & Brown Sweet and Simple Solution!

Mine is clogged. I used the dishwasher and also tried boiling it, but this is too big a nuisance for me. Back to french press or paper filters for me.

This filter has great design and sturdy construction except for the fact that it easily gets clogged and won’t filter coffee. It’s almost too fine. Even after cleaning it and making sure the coffee grounds are really coarse it still will get clogged and doesn’t work too well.

Largest load capability and stable, quite, have a power pulsaltor. Only problem is the hole to add water and connect are not the best, I use for a regular water hole to add water my wash cycle  plus the spin cycle is great not taking clothes out off the wash cycle,  than to the spin cycle too much,  I think I going to get a all-in one wash&spin cycle.

This is probably one of the best investments I could have ever made, I say that because I live in a small apartment and it fit perfectly in a corner of my kitchen.  I usually would spend about 20 - 30 dollars a week in the laundry mat and it was a drag to carry loads and bring them back to the third floor. So when I saw this machine I just had to get it because this way Im doing laundry in my own home even though it is a bit of hands on work but well worth it. I had a bit of problems with the draining but I figured out that the hose has to be at a low level to clean out, so I put it to drain in the bathtub because I use the bathroom to do the laundry.  I use the hose that fits in the back of the machine to fill the tub and after I fill the tub I switch the hose to the spinner and I turn the water and give it  the first minute  to spin the soapy water oit and another minute while the water is running and that is where I add the softener and let that ru. For another minute then I turn. Off the water and reset it to spin all the way. The clothes are spin dry , clean and smelling good. I even bought a clothes rack to dry the clothes off. So far I have saved over 100 dollars. Love this machine and I even tried to look for a bigger machine but had no luck.

After finally getting my new little washing machine. I have had a chance to use it. And I have to say it is the bomb-diggity. It is so awesome . I want 2 of them. It washed my clothes so clean. Of course there's a little bit of work you have to do. But it's nothing like what I was doing I was washing my clothes in the tub with a scrub board. All I have to do is change  the water and put the clothes from the washer tub to the spinner tub. And hang them up on the clothesline. What's up with that? This is the best thing going for the price you can't beat it. It's awesome. If the hoses were longer and of a more durable material I would give it 5 stars. Thank You Della for making this.

This machine has exceeded my expectations. It gets the job done and saves me time at the laundromat.

Tips: The only thing is that even though the capacity is much larger than other portable machines, the motor isn't necessarily more powerful. It gets bogged down if the load is too large, so you will only want to do a few heavy items at a time. Four bath towels was about the most it could handle, or six mens' XL shirts.

You can stuff the spin dryer full and it actually works better that way, but the machine shakes. Half full and it works almost as well and is nearly silent.

Worth every penny.
I love this washing machine,it made me feel home back in my country. Love the pump that used for removing water. I love how i fit it in our apartment.

Love my portable washer does a great job I don't have a laundry site close so this little machine was a good  investment n I recommend this great product for anyone living in small studio apartments perfect for tiny spaces.

This would have been 5 stars if the washer side drain would even drain..I always have to bale out the water after each wash it's so exhausting... Overall the machine washes great and the dryer part is awesome.  The drain pump makes lots of noise and doesn't drains.  What's the best solution to solve the drainage iissue.
Nice and easy
Actually washes quite a lot, and spin dryer is quite effective to get things dry - except my spinner stopped working after 3 months (probably only 5 or 6 uses).

Great, Great, Great product. No more going up and down 3 flights of steps to the community washer (yuk) I have tested it out pretty well. I was able to wash pillows, mattress pads, clothes, curtains etc, etc, everything but the kitchen sink Hee Hee!! I love the idea that no one is using this treasure but my family.. So far everything is working properly clothes are being washed beautifully, the spinner is a absolutely fantastic you literally need to touch the clothes to your face to feel if they are wet. The fully automatic washer where I live doesn't spin the water out of your clothes this well. I hang my clothes on hangers or on my drying rack and they dry very quickly. Some clothing dry within 30 minutes it just really depends on the material... If you have been looking at this machine and wasn't sure if you wanted to purchase it or not I say go for it. It will pay for itself very quickly!!
Someone needs to re-write the user manual.  (trying) to read it and make sense of the tranlation is actually hilarious, but not much help......

I've had this machine for about 2 weeks and I am loving it. I full time rv, it's bigger then I expected but worth it. I do put all my delicatessen and things with straps and strings in zip shut laundry bags, it does tie your pants together and I will be adding a lint catch to the drain hose. Now I can do laundry a little at a time and not speak all day at the laundry mat. 30 munster for wash, rinse and spin, then hang up. I set a box fan on the wet clothes if I leave them over nite, and I hand damp rid dry bags to keep the moisture in the room down. Can't say enuf about this machine
I have had this machine for a week so far and oh my goodness this is an amazing machine! It works great ......definitely you should buy this!
WORKS VERY WELL , DOES A REALLY GOOD JOB IN WASHING

UPDATE 6/24/17:

In early May 2017, I was washing a load of laundry in this washing machine, switched it to the "drain" function, and walked away to let the water drain into my tub, as usual. When I returned to check on it, there was water all over my floor. The drain hose had cracked, causing a huge puddle. I promptly turned the machine off, unscrewed the back, and looked to see if the hose was easily replaceable. It didn't look to be, so I emailed the manufacturer Della through its own website and then the seller (One Big Outlet) through Amazon, asking for a replacement or ideally a refund. I put in two emails to both Della and One Big Outlet, and neither responded over the course of weeks. Della's website literally has no phone number listed, and a Google search yielded no results. One Big Outlet had a phone number that I tried twice, but both times, it went to voicemail and told me I couldn't leave a voicemail because the voicemail box was full. I had purchased Assurant coverage for this, but was told they couldn't help me because it only covered electrical and mechanical damage, not physical damage. It was only after three very long calls to Amazon that Amazon itself agreed to refund me. This was just resolved last week after at least a month of trying for this refund. At the time when the machine broke, I had had it for less than a year and am only one person using it gently. This should not have happened, but it did, so either the manufacturer or sell
The pump to drain the washer isn't working consistently. I've only used it for one month. Any suggestions on what to do would be appreciated.
This unit had a visible bulge on the out side housing when the machine was agitating.
Only used a handful of times and it is a very nice machine
This is AWESOME !!! No more laundrymat .... Just as described ... AWESOME
Very good
Excellent affordable option

The item was delivered on time 09/12/16. I was so happy with my new Twin Tub washing machine. It was really a big help.  No more hand washing. I  used it the moment I received the package, and it works perfectly fine. Thanks to Della Portable Mini Compact Twin Tub Washing Machine... you made my life easy.. no more running to the laundromat.

I read all the listings for a little washing machine before choosing this one. What sold me was it's the largest capacity one out there. When I first got it, I thought it was too big. Now I'm ok with it because you don't have to fill it all the way, you adjust the water level manually to the level you want and wash as few or as many pcs of laundry as you want. The pump expels water very well, which was a concern of mine. My laundry has never gotten cleaner! And I can get all the soap out so no residue! The spin side does an amazing job, better than a full size washer. I think it's only 300 watts to run it! For all the upside, there are a few Cons: I have to use my handheld shower to fill it, the water inlet hoses are useless. My husband made a little wood frame with wheels for it so I can move it into the bathroom to use it. I have to tape the expel hose to the bathtub so it doesn't jump out. The wash cycle timer knob doesn't line up with the times printed around it. Cord is a bit short, but it does have 2 clips to secure it to the back of the washer which is good, and the expel hose has a place on the side to hook onto too.
I was shocked at how powerful this is, both wash cycle and spin. Some water will splash out so be mindful of that when you plug it in. The water hits the lid and runs down and when open, splashes. Over all, it's been a real life saver though. I dare you to take any clean laundry you have and run it through this with just water and just see w

Well. Overall I am extremely satisfied with this purchase. I spent many months researching this product and read dozens if not hundreds of reviews. I came to the conclusion that all of these portable twin tub washers provide the same function and produce the same results. I live in a micro apartment (less than 225 sq. ft.) so my primary concerns were fitting this into my space and avoiding laundromats. I was fully aware of the various complaints made by other reviewers and went into this purchase with eyes wide open.

First. Delivery was in 2 business days.

Second. Package arrived in good condition and washer was well packed inside.

Third. On initial inspection, item appeared new and was undamaged in any way.

Fourth. I wanted to plug it in and check for operation before trying to do a load of wash.

Fifth (and here's why only 4 stars). Sure enough, I plugged it in, turned on the wash-side timer and heard the motor turning, but the agitator wasn't moving. I stopped the was timer and turned on the spin timer. That worked fine. I'm not AT ALL mechanically inclined, but I figured that since I could hear the wash motor turning but the agitator was not, that either there was a loose, missing, broken or unconnected belt. So I tipped the washer over, located the access panel on the bottom rear, removed it and looked inside. There it was. The belt had, in fact, intact come loose from the pulleys between the motor and the agitator. S

It work and did what it was supposed to do ,bUT it could be better. The plastic handle  came off before I can really use it. PLUS it could  not really handle 19lbs of clothes just like 15lbs. I guess I can't complain it is great to have clean clothes.
Absolutely love this washer and spin dryer. Saves us money on full loads and also allows for quick cleaning of a few items when needed. Couldn't be happier!

machine died after 4 months.  came with no warranty but amazon did sell extended warranty through assurant.  assurant will not cover dead machine without written info from della that they will not cover.  one big lot refuses to respond via amazon or their internet store re:  warranty.  i finally got email for della but they will not respond to emails.  and the phone...while this machine when it works is a trojan, no warranty delivered with it or provided by one big lot.  BUYER BEWARE

Big capacity - as of 12/2016 it is the biggest twin tub washer available to the US market. Panda sells two 19lb models but they have been out of stock and their distributor tells me they aren't receiving any for a few more months. So as of now, this Della is the KING of portable washers!

Great washing action. Uses very little laundry detergent like a super high efficiency machine. The biggest issue is the water inlets being on the back of the machine whereas others have them on top. Having them on top is a better design. When they are in the back, water tends to leak due to gravity and the flimsy hose which is far from water tight. Nothing major but expect a few drops on the floor. Considering this Della is almost $100 less than the 19lb Panda, it's a small hassle.

Filling the wash tub takes forever. If you have a 5 gallon bucket, filling it in the shower and then dumping it into the washer would be much faster. I just do it the intended way and multitask while it's filling.

• PRO TIP: Because it takes so long to fill, I generally wash my whites first since they won't bleed and reuse the water for subsequent loads.

• PRO TIP: Rinsing is done in the spinner. The manual doesn't cover this but all you do is connect the water hose to the spinner side and let the faucet run for a minute or two while it's spinning. Turn off the water and let it spin another 2-3 minutes to dry. Easy peezy.

• PRO TIP: Don't overload! The clothes

Bought this machine from the same vendor but not on amazon.
It came on time. The box was beat up. But the washer was in perfect shape. I living in the top of a converted house. So my apartment is smallish...but the layout is the real kicker.
Anyway the washer is huge. 5 normal plush bath towels maybe more if they are super clean.Which leads me to; loading should really be based on soil. I had some super dirty laundry. So I find small loads are easier. You will likely want to wash. Rinse. Rinse. Spin. Or even wash wash rinse rinse spin. But if you get caught up and just toss a days worth of clothes in you can wash.rinse.spin.
On spinning: the timer goes up to 5 mins. Very few things need 5 mins. People bring up not over loading or loading perfect. Don't worry. 1. Everything is plastic. 2. You can reset the stuff 3. I encourage you to reset.
I fill it 3/4 say 3 towels. I set to 35 seconds give or take. Then stop. Reset. Then 30 seconds to 1 min. 2 if it's cotton or other dense non synthetic type.

Do do delicate stuff on high. The top of the "lint" trap with catch and damage stuff.

And if you buy a tiny dryer too. Get stuff super dry. Even half hang dry and get some wool dryer balls. I'm sure all the people bitching about 2 hours for a towel put it in soaking wet. Tbh. I'm buying a little dryer mostly for delinting ...and times I forget to plan.

I have a huge family! My 6 children, husband, grandmother and myself. I wash all of our laundry. My regular washer died on us and I'm still deciding between two different brands for my new set. I got this one, to wash our clothes for now and to have, just in case anything like this happened in the future.

Now. I started using this right out of the box and I used it for 4 days, 12 hours at a time. I had 2 weeks worth of clothes for 9 people! Including bed sets of all sizes even king! I filled it over the fill line, used hot water and put in way more laundry pieces than was recommended. I treated this washer in the worst manor possible!
My wash was super clean! The washer itself is in perfect working order even after the abuse I put it through. Now the 9 of us have clean clothes again and I never had to set foot in a laundromat (that are dirty and other people use.) Ill probably even use this for emergency situations like needing a specific outfit for some type of occasion.

When push came to shove this wonderful little machine saved my family a ton of cash, time, hand washing and unwanted travel.
Mine and a friend of mine both started to leak after a short period and they won't respond ot help. It was working good for the first couple of months. I have the warranty and still can't get help.

My new washer definitely met my expectations. I absolutely love it, and it was delivered in a quick and timely fashion, however, when it arrived the box was all beat up, with holes and scuffs all over it. When I opened the box I immediately put it to a test run before realizing that it had cracks and punctures throughout the washer itself, including the lid was halfway broke off, although, it still worked great. I would have given it 5 stars had it been delivered in better shape. All in all, I love my new washer!!!

I love it ! We are a family of 4 and I can wash a lot of clothes there. It washes very well, and its the biggest capacity (19lb) I'm very happy that I made this purchase. I should have gotten it sooner.
This product is beautiful. The hose and clamp is better than most other washers. I like the size and the spinner disc is much easier to use. Good product.
a most buy if you live in an apartment with kids.

Got my Della unit and found the lids damaged after opening the box. There was no significant visible damage to the box, so it occurred probably when the manufacturer sent it to OneBigOutlet. I contacted them right away and they corrected the situation in a fast and satifiable manor. Dispite the damage, the Della Washer looked very nice; and for the most part, the broken lid hinge, looked well constructed. The damage is disappointing, but I'm no stranger to having a bad apple now and again with online orders. If you can get a good one, it's probably a great unit.

I rate Della 2-stars, but give One Big Outlet 5-stars for handling and taking care of my order. I feel confident that I could do more shopping with them, if something catches my interest.

Update—

I have had my unit now for close to a year. It works great, and have had no issues or any reasons to complain since getting it. It tucks away easily, it’s not overly loud, and it does a very good job. I have washes jeans and shirts covered in paint, it handled it cleaned them very well. Very good little machine!

4/30/19 - Still going.

I've had mine since about August (maybe July?) of 2016. On the plus side, this is fairly compact, which is nice for those of us living in small spaces, and yet it still manages to wash a decent amount in a single go. The spin dry works fairly well, too, for what it is.

It stopped draining at all in April 2017, which is when it was discovered that the hose was clogged - and that this was somehow fixed by blowing into the hose. My landlord figured that one out for me. So if you're having similar trouble, that might help.

I don't have the space for a full-sized washer and dryer, and overall this washer has been more convenient for me than going out to a laundromat.

So all the reviews I read about this machine were accurate. You need to put a little work into it for it to be just perfect.
What you will need:
Garden Hose
Hose connecting Adapter
Clamp Rings
Eye Hoods
Craft Wire

Working with what you have:
The hose is 2 small and you need an adapter. I found a simple solution by going to home depot and getting a clear hose to attach to the hose. Before inserting the hose I inserted a plastic connector into the open end of the washing machine hose.
This allowed the hose to remain in place in the clear hose.
I then used clamp rings to make sure it would not come out and hold it together.
I have made this portable mini washing machine into a non-movable one by putting the hose to drain in the sink.
I attached eye hooks to the wall and used craft wire to wrap around the hose and threaded it through the hooks.
The hose for intake is also too small.
Easy fix for that situation as well.
I took a garden hose found an adapter for my kitchen sink ( don't drink tap water anyway so removed tap filter to place adapter)
Now when I want to use the machine I only have to connect the hose and fill the tub with hot or cold water depending on what I'm washing.
